items.title: An element cutting the support down by one acts as a nonzerodivisor on a Cohen-Macaulay module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a Cohen-Macaulay module over a Noetherian local ring, an element g whose vanishing cuts the support down by exactly one is a nonzerodivisor with Cohen-Macaulay quotient of depth one less (statement lines 25234-25241). The proof does not measure depths directly: it invokes the good element lemma when g is good with respect to a maximal regular sequence, and otherwise chooses a further element h cutting the support down, arguing on quotients that both g and h act injectively (proof lines 25243-25266). Finding the auxiliary element h so that the induction applies is the content. H2.
